title: Classic Latke's Recipe
author: Lenny Teytelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baxfifjn

steps.title: Wash potatoes (no peel)
steps.instruction: Do not peel; wash six Russet potatoes thoroughly.

steps.title: Grate potatoes and onion
steps.instruction: Using a food processor or hand grater, grate the potatoes and one onion with the coarse disc/side directly into a bowl.

steps.title: Remove excess moisture
steps.instruction: Transfer the potato/onion mixture onto a clean cloth towel, squeeze out as much moisture as possible, then return the dried mixture to the bowl.

steps.title: Season and bind mixture
steps.instruction: Add salt, pepper, baking powder, and eggs to the bowl and mix well.

steps.title: Heat oil in pan
steps.instruction: Cover the bottom of a frying pan with oil to a depth of about ¼ inch, then heat to medium‑high.

steps.title: Form and fry latkes
steps.instruction: Scoop roughly one tablespoon of the mixture per latke (fits 6–10 latkes per pan depending on size), place on the hot pan, fry 4–5 minutes until edges turn golden brown, flip, and fry an additional 4–5 minutes.

steps.title: Drain and season latkes
steps.instruction: Transfer cooked latkes to a large plate lined with paper towels, sprinkle a little salt after each batch, and serve.
